flawless: The more who stand before me, the harder I strike. You stood alone, and fell alone.
Elsdragon's blade sings, and you barely heard its first note.
solid: A fine fight, friend! Give it a decade in the woods and you'll make a fair warrior.
You drew elven blood, and few can claim that.
close: Ha! I nearly met my ancestors. They'll have to wait for another tale.
The forest held its breath for that one, and so did I.
